claim: DailyMed labeling for dimethyl fumarate states that its therapeutic mechanism in MS is unknown while DMF and monomethyl fumarate have been shown to activate the Nrf2 pathway.
future_grounding_route: Could be used to prioritize future external-verifiable pharmacodynamic hypotheses, but cannot reinterpret the project's DMF treatment-response signal without a separate grounded analysis.
project_use: External DMT mechanism-label context; not evidence for the V22/V32 treatment-response lead.

source_terms.reuse_notes: External label-context metadata only; do not redistribute full label text or treat label wording as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun FDA/DailyMed label generation or regulatory label text from held data.
